# Fixture Notes

Use these scenarios when expanding automated tests for `ls-shadcn-ui-components`:

- Next.js App Router with RSC and TypeScript.
- Vite SPA with TypeScript.
- React Router framework project.
- TanStack Start project.
- Astro project with React integration.
- Laravel plus Vite project.
- Monorepo with shared UI package.
- Tailwind projects.
- JavaScript project with `tsx: false`.
- Radix and Base UI style variants.
- Custom aliases and package imports.
- Custom `iconLibrary`.
- Installed-component update checks.
- `use client` placement checks.

The current smoke row uses the verifier help command because it is deterministic
and offline.
